question: How to recognzie and suppress OCT autocorrelation artifact.

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: The answer explains that recognizing OCT artifacts requires accurately differentiating true tissue/vascular signals from noise or spurious signals that mimic real structures.
examples: Artifacts mimic real vascular structures and must be separated from true signal
Recognition involves differentiating true vascular signals from noise to preserve angiographic image quality

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: The answer identifies autocorrelation noise as a specific class of coherent OCT artifact arising from self-interference within the system (e.g., the sample arm), which degrades image clarity and must be suppressed.
examples: Autocorrelation noise arises from coherent self-interference and contaminates the OCT signal
Autocorrelation artifacts obscure structural detail and reduce image clarity

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: The answer presents Resonant OCT (ROCT) as a novel approach that eliminates autocorrelation noise by preventing artifact formation at the source, enhancing clarity without compromising signal integrity.
examples: ROCT prevents autocorrelation artifact formation, yielding noise-free OCT images
ROCT uses resonance to remove autocorrelation noise while preserving the true signal

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: The answer describes computational algorithms that cancel coherent artifacts by separating genuine tissue reflections from coherent noise sources, improving image accuracy.
examples: Algorithms separate true tissue reflections from coherent noise
Coherent artifact cancellation improves the accuracy of OCT images

ingredients.name: answer_critical_4
ingredients.criterion: The answer covers spectral domain OCT methods for eliminating autocorrelation artifacts, including real-time volume-rate processing and a cost-effective technique for complete removal of arbitrarily strong and located artifacts.
examples: Real-time processing removes autocorrelation artifacts in volume-rate SD-OCT
A cost-effective SD-OCT method completely removes arbitrarily strong/located autocorrelation artifacts

ingredients.name: answer_critical_5
ingredients.criterion: The answer details artifact removal in Fourier-domain OCT using a piezoelectric fiber stretcher, where mechanical modulation of the optical path decorrelates and mitigates autocorrelation terms.
examples: A piezoelectric fiber stretcher modulates the optical path to remove autocorrelation artifacts in FD-OCT

ingredients.name: valuable_0
ingredients.criterion: The answer organizes suppression methods into hardware-based prevention (ROCT, fiber stretcher) versus algorithmic post-processing removal (coherent artifact cancellation), or otherwise compares their mechanisms across cited works.
examples: ROCT prevents formation; cancellation algorithms remove existing artifacts
Hardware approaches like ROCT prevent artifact formation, while algorithms cancel artifacts post-detection

ingredients.name: valuable_1
ingredients.criterion: The answer notes practical attributes of the methods (real-time capability, speed, cost-effectiveness, broad applicability) and concludes that artifact recognition and suppression improve OCT/OCTA image clarity, accuracy, and diagnostic reliability.
examples: The technique is efficient, cost-effective, and applicable in diverse imaging scenarios
Suppressing autocorrelation artifacts improves image clarity and diagnostic accuracy
